entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help. I need to return an item. It's a pair of cycling shoes.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear they didn't work out. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just the fit. I tried them on one ride, and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but it didn't help. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for these for months, and I really needed this money if they weren't perfect.
Oh no, getting blisters is the last thing we want from a ride. I completely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay. I've been a loyal customer for years, I was just hoping this would be simple.

Of course. And thank you for your loyalty, we truly appreciate it. Okay, I see your order here. The cycling shoes were delivered 7 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried.

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that for you now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. All you need to do is package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at the post office.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana! You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the return, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
